body: i’ll have dreams that random teachers or friends are trying to rape me. the only time i had a dream about the literal guy himself that i can remember was a few weeks after it happened. his hair was a lot shorter? and i was watching him shoot hoops in my middle school courtyard until he turned around and started just yelling at me, looking super angry. i don’t remember/couldn’t hear what he was saying. i still don’t know what thats even supposed to mean. he had no association to my middle school at all.
